text:
incidents-bot: [ALERT] 09:12:23 UTC — 5xx rate spike detected on /v1/route (prompt-router-v2 canary). 3m breach, p95 latency up. Paging oncall @Alex N :rotating_light:

deploy-bot: Canary rollout cr-2026-07-21-09 started at 09:10:11 UTC -> prompt-router-v2 (5% traffic).

Alex N: I'm up. grabbing logs now. Mira/Sam/Lucy - please standby.

Sam K: seeing a lot of `ModelVariantNotFound` from the canary pods. Example error from logs:```json
{"ts":"2026-07-21T09:12:18Z","level":"error","msg":"ModelVariantNotFound","route":"/v1/route","variant":"pr-v2-alpha","req_id":"req_42f"}```

Lucy Zhao: Clients hitting the canary are mostly Dedicated customers in eu-west. Customer Ops shows spikes for corp-alpha and corp-omega.

Mira Patel: quick check — routing table shows the new endpoint name `prompt-router-v2` present, but many nodes return 404 for variant lookup. Could be model registry mismatch after deploy.

Alex N: if this is a variant lookup we should kill the feature flag and route back to prompt-router-v1. I'm going to prepare the kill.

Alex N: Triggering feature flag kill-switch (console):
```bash
curl -sS -X POST \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  https://console.redwood.internal/api/flags/prompt_router_v2/override \ 
  -d '{"enabled":false,"reason":"canary 5xxs variant lookup failures","actor":"alex@redwood.com"}'
```

incidents-bot: Feature flag override recorded: prompt_router_v2.enabled=false by Alex N @ 09:15:02 UTC. Rolling traffic back to prompt-router-v1 per policy.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback initiated for cr-2026-07-21-09. Redirecting 100% of traffic to prompt-router-v1 routing table.

Sam K: metrics look like they're coming down — 5xx rate halved in 30s, p95 latency dropping.

Lucy Zhao: Confirming dedicated customers corp-alpha & corp-omega show error rates normalizing. Alerting both with a short note (CC: Customer Ops).

Customer Ops Bot: Notified corp-alpha and corp-omega: "We observed elevated errors 09:12-09:15 UTC during an internal canary. We've rolled back and are monitoring. We'll follow up with a post-incident summary."

Mira Patel: handing on-call to @Mira Patel for the remainder of the incident window. Alex, please stay until postmortem notes.

Alex N: will stay. Quick mitigation notes: root suspect = model registry sync race during canary pod startup that caused variant lookup to fail.

Sam K: saving a snippet of the problematic pod logs and kube events:```bash
kubectl logs pod/prompt-router-v2-5f7 --since=10m
# shows repeated lookup 404s to model-registry service
kubectl get events --namespace=ml | grep prompt-router-v2
```

Mira Patel: severity assessment — SEV3. Customer impact: ~2 dedicated customers, spike lasted ~3 minutes from 09:12 to 09:15 UTC. Estimated failed requests ~1.2k, no data exfiltration.

Alex N: creating incident ticket in Jira INC-4527 with timeline, command snippets, and customer impact. Will include rollback steps and FF kill-switch steps.

Lucy Zhao: scheduling postmortem for tomorrow 10:00 UTC, invite: Eng Runtime, Eng ML, DevEx, Customer Ops.

Sam K: follow-up actions I will own: (1) add validation to canary startup to ensure model-registry sync before accepting traffic, (2) add an automated metric to alert on variant-lookup-404s earlier, (3) run a dry-run of rollout spec.

Alex N: thanks team. marking channel resolved when metrics stable for 15m. :white_check_mark:

incidents-bot: Resolution checkpoint at 09:30:23 UTC — 5xx and latency within normal thresholds for 10m. Incident marked as mitigated.

Mira Patel: handed over to oncall rotation; Alex please add any final notes to INC-4527.

Alex N: added notes + logs to ticket. final customer impact summary for postmortem: "Canary-induced variant lookup failures caused a short 3-minute spike affecting two dedicated customers. Immediate mitigation: feature flag override and canary rollback. No ongoing impact."

Lucy Zhao: will send customer-facing follow-up tomorrow after postmortem. Thanks everyone. :pray:
